# Multi-AI Brainstorm for Muse

Multi-AI Brainstorm asks the same question to several free AIs at once, without opening a browser. Give it a topic, and it sends the same prompt to each free voice, collects every answer, removes duplicates, keeps the ideas that come back often and the best unique ones, then gives you a short top list with the source of each idea. Wild ideas are kept apart, not thrown away.

No browser is needed for a run. Right now, by default, it goes through Pollinations, with no key and no account at all (one small model, gpt-oss-20b, about one request every 15 seconds). That is enough to test it.

How to add more voices, all free, no card. Do each one once, then it just works:
- Pollinations with a key: make a free account at enter.pollinations.ai, get your free Seed key. It unlocks more models and goes faster, about one request every 5 seconds.
- Gemini: open Google AI Studio with your Google account, create a free API key, no card needed.
- Groq: make a free account on the Groq console, create a free API key, no card needed.
- OpenRouter: make a free account, create a free API key, and use the models ending in :free.

Never paste a key in the chat and never put one in a file. Tell your Muse which key you made, it opens a secure entry card, you type the key there, and it lives in the secure vault from then on.

Tested live, 2026-11-08, no browser: Pollinations answered in about 13 seconds with 5 name ideas. The same small model drifted off topic on a second test, which is why the skill...
